notes.title: Major difficulty reduction
notes.content:
Hello, players. This is Team Hanahana🌸.

Thanks to the feedback from our players, we have added save points at each phase of the boss maps.

Additionally, Calm Down, Princess! has undergone several adjustments as detailed below. We are eagerly waiting for brave heroes to set new official clear records on this now easier difficulty level!

June 9

Made the pop-up hints on the Castle map easier.
June 22

Added multiple save points to the Snow White and Mermaid maps.
Made the trigger for the Green Dwarf on the Apple map more explicit (For those who missed it, the trigger is the purple apple ^^..).
Added a hint for the lasers on the Mirror map.
Nerfed patterns 1, 2, and 4 of the Snow White boss; removed random elements from patterns 1-1 to 1-4 and adjusted the moss wall in pattern 1.
Nerfed the Mermaid boss.
Reduced the hitbox size for spikes.
Added a save point in pattern 4.
Reduced the frequency of falling embers in the Castle map's upward section.
Removed spikes in overly difficult sections of the Mermaid map.
Adjusted the flames in the closing section of the Castle map to recede after appearing.
August 20

Added save points at each phase of the boss maps.
